raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`SRTPlatform.get_dispatch_key_name()` is the seam that picks a `BaseFusedOp`'s `forward_<key>()`, but only out-of-tree platforms go through it. In-tree dispatch resolves the key from a separate `is_cuda / is_hip / is_cpu+AMX / is_npu / is_xpu / is_musa` chain in `kernels/fused_op.py`, so two sources answer "which device is this", and they can disagree. For example, with `SGLANG_USE_CPU_ENGINE=1` on a CUDA host, the platform resolves to `CpuSRTPlatform` while op dispatch still keys on `cuda`.

This is the first of a few PRs that route the in-tree platforms through the `SRTPlatform` seams that already exist, so that out-of-tree platforms aren't the only users of those seams.

## Modifications

- Each in-tree platform overrides `get_dispatch_key_name()`:

  | Platform | Key |
  |---|---|
  | CUDA | `cuda` |
  | ROCm | `hip` |
  | MUSA | `musa` |
  | NPU | `npu` (already overridden) |
  | XPU | `xpu` |
  | CPU | `cpu` with AMX, `native` otherwise (the old `is_cpu() and cpu_has_amx_support()` rule) |
  | MPS and the base platform | `native` (default) |

- `fused_op._platform_key()` reads `current_platform.get_dispatch_key_name()` and maps `native` to `""`, which is the plain-native key it already used. The out-of-tree path (`_oot_dispatch_key`) is unchanged.
- `_is_cuda_available()` now also requires `torch.version.cuda`, matching `is_cuda()`. A `torch.cuda` shim over another device no longer resolves to the CUDA platform; torchada's opt-in `TORCHADA_FORCE_CUDA_AVAILABLE` on MUSA is the case that matters. Without that switch, torchada never patches `torch.cuda.is_available()` or `torch.version.cuda`, so default MUSA resolution doesn't change.
- Tests:
  - the per-platform keys, including CPU with and without AMX;
  - `_platform_key()` reading the key from the platform;
  - `_is_cuda_available()` rejecting a non-CUDA build.

Behaviour is unchanged on CUDA, ROCm, NPU, XPU, MUSA, MPS and AMX/non-AMX CPU. The only change is the CPU engine on a CUDA host, which now dispatches CPU paths instead of `forward_cuda`.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: no kernel or forward change. Dispatch keys are identical on every in-tree platform except the CPU-engine-on-a-CUDA-host case above.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
  - `test/registered/unit/platforms/`, `test/registered/unit/kernels/test_fused_op_dispatch.py` and `test/registered/unit/plugins/`: 139 passed locally on CPU.

@@ -166,35 +166,11 @@ def _platform() -> PlatformInfo:
 
 @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
 def _platform_key() -> str:
-    """In-tree platform dispatch key, or ``""`` for plain-native platforms.
-
-    Checked in the same order as the former ``MultiPlatformOp``: CPU counts
-    only when AMX is available (otherwise the pure-torch reference is faster
-    than pretending there is an optimized CPU path).
-    """
-    from sglang.srt.utils import (
-        cpu_has_amx_support,
-        is_cpu,
-        is_cuda,
-        is_hip,
-        is_musa,
-        is_npu,
-        is_xpu,
-    )
+    """In-tree platform dispatch key, or ``""`` for plain-native platforms."""
+    from sglang.srt.platforms import current_platform
 
-    if is_cuda():
-        return "cuda"
-    if is_hip():
-        return "hip"
-    if is_cpu() and cpu_has_amx_support():
-        return "cpu"
-    if is_npu():
-        return "npu"
-    if is_xpu():
-        return "xpu"
-    if is_musa():
-        return "musa"
-    return ""
+    key = current_platform.get_dispatch_key_name()
+    return "" if key == "native" else key
 
 
 @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)

@@ -34,7 +34,11 @@
 
 
 def _is_cuda_available() -> bool:
-    return bool(torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.version.hip is None)
+    return bool(
+        torch.cuda.is_available()
+        and torch.version.hip is None
+        and torch.version.cuda is not None
+    )
 
 
 def _is_rocm_available() -> bool:

@@ -120,3 +120,8 @@ class CpuSRTPlatform(CpuDeviceMixin, SRTPlatform):
 
     def is_pin_memory_available(self, device=None) -> bool:
         return False
+
+    def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:
+        from sglang.srt.utils.common import cpu_has_amx_support
+
+        return "cpu" if cpu_has_amx_support() else "native"

@@ -109,3 +109,6 @@ class CudaSRTPlatform(CudaDeviceMixin, SRTPlatform):
         piecewise_graph=True,
         hicache_device_kernels=True,
     )
+
+    def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:
+        return "cuda"

@@ -232,10 +232,11 @@ def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:
         """Return the dispatch key name for BaseFusedOp
         (``sglang.kernels.fused_op``).
 
-        Determines which ``forward_<key>()`` method is selected on an
-        out-of-tree platform. E.g. "cuda", "npu", "hip", "xpu", "cpu".
-        Forwards registered via ``BaseFusedOp.register_oot_forward`` with
-        this key take precedence over the method lookup.
+        Determines which ``forward_<key>()`` method is selected, e.g. "cuda",
+        "npu", "hip", "xpu", "cpu"; "native" selects ``forward_native``. On an
+        out-of-tree platform, forwards registered via
+        ``BaseFusedOp.register_oot_forward`` with this key take precedence
+        over the method lookup.
         """
         return "native"

@@ -23,3 +23,6 @@ class MusaSRTPlatform(MusaDeviceMixin, SRTPlatform):
     """Default in-tree MUSA SRT platform."""
 
     capabilities = PlatformCapabilities(supports_triton=True, graph_capture=True)
+
+    def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:
+        return "musa"

@@ -29,3 +29,6 @@ class RocmSRTPlatform(RocmDeviceMixin, SRTPlatform):
         piecewise_graph=True,
         hicache_device_kernels=True,
     )
+
+    def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:

@@ -99,3 +99,6 @@ class XpuSRTPlatform(XpuDeviceMixin, SRTPlatform):

+
+    def get_dispatch_key_name(self) -> str:

@@ -181,6 +181,24 @@ def test_platform_default_chains(monkeypatch, key, expect):

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "platform_key, expect", [("cuda", "cuda"), ("npu", "npu"), ("native", "")]
+)
+def test_in_tree_key_comes_from_the_platform(monkeypatch, platform_key, expect):
+    import sglang.srt.platforms as platforms
+
+    class _Platform:
